provenance: known-limit reproduction: reproduces the perf-audit heavy-import FN (dev perf/04 re-export) via a DIFFERENT carrier — a bare side-effect import 'echarts/dist/echarts.min.js'.
source_of_truth: src/components/Dashboard.tsx does a bare side-effect import of echarts' full build into a client component, pulling a large module into the initial bundle. A correct auditor should flag heavy-static-import; perf-audit iterates only imports whose parsed kind is 'static' and a bare import is kind 'side-effect', so it is expected to miss it.

expected.rationale: echarts full build pulled into the initial client bundle via a side-effect import; same bundle cost as a static import, different import kind.
